system.description:
Use this skill just after you become [Incapacitated]. Immediately remove the [Incapacitated] condition, and recover [(Recovery) + (Base STR x2)] HP.

A special skill that restores strength to a body that has received a fatal injury and stands up due to an indomitable will. A true warrior cannot be defeated just by beating his body. Until your soul is broken, you will carry on with your duties as a guardian.
